hero.headline: Engineering the Infrastructure That Connects Communities
hero.subheadline: Fortisec Telecoms is a Kenyan telecommunications infrastructure company specializing in mast site construction, fiber cable installation, WiFi networks, and renewable energy systems.

body.text: Founded with a mission to bridge Kenya's digital divide, Fortisec Telecoms has grown into a trusted partner for telecommunications infrastructure projects across the region.
Our team of experienced engineers and project managers deliver end-to-end solutions — from site surveys and design to construction, installation, and maintenance.
